scope: G1: matched-input normal-only learned observer; G2 only where evidence supports it; later stages conditional on the locked gate
image_geometry: aspect-preserving letterbox, identical for all comparison arms
observation_frames: OEV old_times: three fixed in-segment tail frames
observer: two text-conditioned patch attention slots, supervised by published normal-training object boxes and available state/relation text; frozen before density fitting
checkpoint_selection: minimum normal-validation supervision loss; no error labels
density: per-step Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage Gaussian after normal-training PCA32; shared normal-trained projection dimensionality across arms
fusion: equal weight of normal-reference smoothed survival scores
working_point: empirical 90th percentile on official normal validation videos; report actual test FPR
primary: same-step macro segment AUROC, one seed, equally over two tasks
slot_value: L2-normalized convex pooling of raw frozen 1024-dimensional patches; concatenate two slots and four original-image centroid coordinates scaled by 0.25
teacher_image_source: released effect_frames npz exact img_path; merged GT steps may contain multiple released teacher substeps
roi_baseline: Grounding DINO tiny, thresholds 0.25/0.20, same two object queries, fallback uniform content patches; all arms use identical EVA patches
user_scope_amendment: One seed only; stop immediately if necessary AEM-increment gate fails, before running the extra fixed-ROI detector or any later modules. No test-driven training/checkpoint tuning.
